skins.subtitle: Browse Ely.by skins, manage your personal collection, or upload a custom skin.
skins.searchPlaceholder: Search skins by username or tag...

settings.title: Launcher Settings
settings.subtitle: Configure accounts, language, Java runtimes, RAM allocation, and launcher behavior.

language.title: Language
language.description: Choose the display language for the launcher interface. New locale files in src/locales/ hot-reload automatically.

theme.title: Appearance & Theme
theme.description: Choose your preferred color theme or automatically follow your system preference.
theme.autoDesc: Automatically switch between dark and light based on OS settings
theme.darkDesc: Dark theme designed for low-light environments
theme.lightDesc: Clean, bright interface for daytime use

accounts.title: Accounts & Authentication
accounts.description: Connect your Ely.by or offline accounts. Sensitive tokens are secured in the OS Credential Vault.
accounts.keyringActive: Native OS Keyring active: Tokens are encrypted using Windows Credential Manager (DPAPI) / Keychain.
accounts.empty: No accounts configured yet. Click "Add Account" to get started with Ely.by.

memory.title: Memory Allocation (RAM)
memory.description: Configure initial (Min) and maximum (Max) RAM limits for Java and Minecraft instances.
memory.highMemoryWarningDesc: Allocating {{maxGb}} GB (> 80% of your {{totalGb}} GB total RAM) may cause background applications, Discord, or Windows to become unresponsive.
memory.memoryNoticeDesc: Max RAM is greater than currently free memory ({{availableGb}} GB). Ensure heavy background apps are closed before launching heavy instances.

behavior.title: Launcher Behavior
behavior.description: Choose what happens when an instance is launched.

keepOpen.label: Keep Open
keepOpen.description: Stay open in the background while playing

hideToTray.label: Hide to Tray
hideToTray.description: Minimize to tray and restore on game exit

close.label: Close Launcher
close.description: Close Ingot completely after game starts

window.title: Window & Display
window.description: Configure default window dimensions and fullscreen startup mode for your instances.
window.fullscreenDesc: Launch Minecraft directly into borderless or exclusive fullscreen
window.resolutionDesc: Set custom width and height for game window

sync.title: Game Data Synchronization
sync.description: Keep your Minecraft configurations, servers, and assets aligned across all instances.

syncOptions.title: Sync Game Options
syncOptions.description: Video settings, audio volume, FOV, keybindings, and accessibility

syncServers.title: Sync Multiplayer Servers
syncServers.description: Keep your saved server list unified across all instances

syncResourcePacks.title: Sync Resource Packs
syncResourcePacks.description: Share all downloaded texture and resource packs across instances

syncCommandHistory.title: Sync Command History
syncCommandHistory.description: Preserve chat and console command history across launches

syncCreativeHotbars.title: Sync Saved Creative Hotbars
syncCreativeHotbars.description: Share saved hotbar layouts in creative mode across worlds

updates.title: Updates & Version
updates.description: Manage Ingot updates and ensure you are running the latest features and security fixes.

updates.upToDate: Ingot is up to date. You are running the latest version.
